paper_title: Constraints on photon mass and dark photon from the Jovian magnetic field
notes: Paper constrains both SM photon mass (mγ < 2.5×10⁻¹⁸ eV at 95% CL) and dark photon parameters (mX, ε) using Juno magnetometer data from Jupiter's magnetic field. The dark photon constraint is strongest in the mass range 3.2×10⁻¹⁸ eV ≤ mX ≤ 1.8×10⁻¹⁵ eV and is independent of dark photon relic density. Main result: ε ≤ 2.8×10⁻³ at mX = 2.0×10⁻¹⁵ eV. At ε = 1, the bounds are mX ≤ 3.2×10⁻¹⁸ eV or mX ≥ 3.2×10⁻¹⁴ eV. The paper uses Bayesian analysis with Jeffreys prior. Data points extracted from Fig. 7 and text (Section 5). The constraint improves Pioneer 10 limits by ~2 orders of magnitude for photon mass and ~50× for dark photon kinetic mixing in the optimal mass range. | selector: text (sole candidate)
